messages:
harper (support): FYI escalation from NoviHealth. Their production traffic started getting function validation errors around 02:10 UTC. Customer says identical traffic works in staging. Ticket #CS-3482. Logs show ToolValidationError for arg 'items'.

harper (support): Paste from our function-runner logs: 

```
2026-03-10T02:10:03Z INFO incoming request /v1/chat/completions id=ch_01F... org=novihealth
2026-03-10T02:10:03Z DEBUG function_call payload: {
  "name": "process_batch",
  "arguments": { "items": "[{\"id\":\"a1\",\"value\":123}]" }
}
2026-03-10T02:10:03Z ERROR ToolValidationError: argument 'items' expected array<object> but got string
```

harper (support): Note the items arg looks double-encoded (string containing JSON array). Customer's client library apparently JSON.stringify()s the whole tool arguments then the agent also stringified the array. They only started high-volume prod after yesterday's rollout.

raj (eng-runtime): Ugh, thanks. That explains why staging didn't trip — their staging proxy was doing a shallow stringify whereas prod's edge wrapper does a stringify+escape for some payloads.

luis (oncall): Can we short-circuit this in the runtime to attempt a one-time coercion? i.e., if schema expects array/object and value is string, try JSON.parse and re-run validation. Low-risk hotfix and we can enable for the org only.

raj (eng-runtime): We can. Two options: 1) Apply input-coercion middleware that attempts JSON.parse for strings for top-level args that fail validation. 2) Add a per-org feature-flag (--toolcall-coerce=true) and enable for NoviHealth. Option 2 is safer. We'll need a canary and quick rollback.

marta (acct-mgr): Customer wants a workaround they can toggle immediately on their side. Do they have a setting in their agent? They said they upgraded yesterday.

harper (support): They do not have a toggle exposed; their SDK is proprietary. They're asking us to fix on our side or provide a rollback.

raj (eng-runtime): I'll prepare a small canary that enables coercion for org id `org_novihealth` and for 5% of requests initially. Implementation: middleware before schema validator: if expected type is array/object and actual value is string, attempt safe JSON.parse; if parse yields expected type, replace and proceed. Will log parse attempts.

harper (support): Repro steps from customer (they provided):
```
# JS client snippet they said they run in prod
const payload = { items: JSON.stringify([{ id: 'a1', value: 123 }]) };
await fetch('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat/completions', {
  method: 'POST',
  headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
  body: JSON.stringify({ messages, function_call: { name: 'process_batch', arguments: payload } })
});
```

harper (support): In staging their proxy does `payload.items = JSON.stringify(payload.items)` only once; in prod their edge wrapper does an extra stringify. So double-encoded.

luis (oncall): For immediate relief we can: A) enable org-scoped coercion flag for NoviHealth; B) ask them to rollback agent to previous version; C) set up request transform at our edge to detect `"[{` prefix in string values and attempt parse. Option A is fastest.

raj (eng-runtime): I'm going to open PR for org-scoped coercion. Will include telemetry: count of coerced fields, parsing errors, and rejection rate. Also add an opt-out header X-Disable-ToolCoerce for debug.

harper (support): Customer asked for ETA. Can we do a hotfix today?

raj (eng-runtime): I can get a canary out within 90 minutes assuming no perf regression. Will ping when deployed.

deploy-bot: started deploy canary/service=runtime-coerce org_filter=org_novihealth -> canary id=dc-789

deploy-bot: canary healthy after 3 minutes, routed 5% of traffic for org_novihealth

harper (support): Customer confirmed reduced errors on canary traffic. They still see some errors for older messages stuck in their queue.

marta (acct-mgr): Noting customer concern: they'd prefer a stable long-term fix in their SDK. We'll coordinate a joint postmortem and recommend SDK patch.

raj (eng-runtime): Next steps: 1) Extend coercion to handle nested stringified objects (we already parse top-level args). 2) Run canary for 24 hours. 3) If stable, promote to 100% for org_novihealth and add a global opt-in flag. 4) Follow-up PR to make coercion stricter: only coerce when parse result matches expected JSON schema to avoid accidental coercion.

harper (support): Also add a one-line note to CS triage playbook: "If tool validation fails with expected array/object but value is string, try org-scoped coercion or request SDK rollback."

luis (oncall): I've set pager duty to low for this; will keep monitoring. If coercion causes >0.1% parse errors we'll roll back.

harper (support): Thanks team — updating ticket #CS-3482 with mitigation and repro. Will follow up on PM/PO for SDK outreach.

raj (eng-runtime): PR link: https://git.redwood.internal/runtime/pulls/1227 (draft). I'll convert to ready and request review.

harper (support): Leaving this thread as the single source for the incident notes. If anyone observes anomalies please post here. :thumbsup:
